governance.scopeChange: Do not add mandatory items, raise targets, or split/reweight items during execution without explicit user approval. Record proposals in deferredBacklog. A defect that prevents an existing criterion is fixed within that item, not new scope.
governance.noSpeculativeHardening: Tie every implementation/hardening change to a failing criterion, missing required evidence, or a reproducible defect under a checklist ID. Stop improving a satisfied criterion.
governance.unknownFirst: Before building a not_audited item, inspect and qualify existing code; reuse Books, Documents, Signing and mobile work. Complete baseline qualification before interpreting percentages as a total completion estimate.
governance.workUnit: At turn start name checklist IDs and the evidence needed. At turn end update status, evidence and the next concrete action. A log entry without item progress is not completion.
governance.evidence: No full-workflow credit for source checks, mocked service tests or single-session SQL fixtures. Real provider, full-schema, concurrency, browser and measured performance requirements remain separate.
governance.verificationFreshness: Record source hashes and environment for proof. Changed evidence dependencies invalidate that proof until reassessed. Existing live environment is production; no customer test mutations.
governance.blocking: External gates never silently disappear or count as complete. Report implementation complete awaiting external acceptance when only these remain; do not keep generating features.
governance.regressions: Preserve existing residential/commercial and mixed-org behavior. Use agreed regression checks; repeated broad tests require a code change, failure or unresolved concern.
governance.finish: When all mandatory items are accepted and no launch blocker remains, complete the goal and move optional enhancements to a separate backlog.

statusDefinitions.not_audited: Existing capability not sufficiently assessed; neither missing nor implemented credit.
statusDefinitions.pending: Known unmet criterion or required new acceptance task.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some relevant implementation exists; at least one criterion remains incomplete or unqualified.
statusDefinitions.implemented: Every functional criterion has code or the required engineering artifact; required integration/QA proof or release gates still remain.
statusDefinitions.verified: Every verificationRequired tier has fresh successful evidence against every criterion.
statusDefinitions.accepted: Verified, deployment/activation is complete or explicitly not applicable, all release dependencies are accepted, and the release owner records acceptance.

progressRules.implementation: Sum frozen weights for implemented, verified or accepted / all mandatory weights. No fractional credit for partial.
progressRules.verification: Sum weights for verified or accepted / all mandatory weights.
progressRules.releaseReady: Sum weights for accepted / all mandatory weights.
progressRules.automationCoverage: Separate count of items with passing isolated automated evidence. This is not verified/readiness progress.
progressRules.weights: Fixed relative complexity estimates: 1 narrow capability, 2 workflow, 3 transactional/multi-system/operational requirement. These are not remaining-time estimates.
progressRules.uncertainty: Until not_audited items are qualified, implementation percentage is a documented lower bound, not a project ETA or replacement for the earlier rough 30% estimate.
